IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_1: Hey! Good to see a friendly face.
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_2: You made it. Come on, catch your breath.
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_4: Easy now. Who are you with?
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_5: Hello there. Keep your hands where I can see them.
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_6: We trade, we don't shoot. Same goes for you.
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_8: Fresh meat walking right up to us.
IGUI_LK_Speech_greet_9: You've got some nerve showing your face here.
IGUI_LK_Speech_warn_1: Careful, friend. Give us a little room.
IGUI_LK_Speech_warn_3: Stop right there. State your business.
IGUI_LK_Speech_warn_4: One more step and you're done.
IGUI_LK_Speech_warn_5: Turn around and walk away. Last warning.
IGUI_LK_Warn_1_1: Hold it right there. That's close enough.
IGUI_LK_Warn_1_2: Stop. This place is taken. Turn around.
IGUI_LK_Warn_2_2: Not one more step. I mean it.
IGUI_LK_Warn_3_hold: I won't say it again. Walk away. Now.
IGUI_LK_Warn_3_shot: That one was a warning. The next one isn't.
IGUI_LK_Warn_Again: You again? I told you to stay away!
IGUI_LK_Speech_alert_3: I count at least a dozen. Form up!
IGUI_LK_Speech_hurt_3: I can patch this up myself, give me a minute.
IGUI_LK_Speech_hungry_1: When did we last eat a real meal?
IGUI_LK_Speech_hungry_3: You wouldn't have a can of something to spare?
IGUI_LK_Speech_hungry_4: Somebody out there's got food. We just have to go and take it.
IGUI_LK_Speech_rest_3: Quiet day. I don't trust it.
IGUI_LK_Speech_rest_4: Back to work after a short break.
IGUI_LK_Speech_farewell_2: Come back whenever you like. In one piece.
IGUI_LK_Speech_farewell_4: Don't bring any of them back with you.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_1: Hard times, but we're holding on.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_2: We're trying to make this place a home.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_3: Heard anything on the radio lately?
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_4: Not much to say. Times are what they are.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_5: No time. Go and ask someone else.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_6: We've got nothing to say to you.
IGUI_LK_Speech_smalltalk_7: Talk is cheap. What have you got?
IGUI_LK_Refuse_guard_wound: I can barely stand. Someone else takes the watch.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_guard_morale: Stand guard again? Not tonight. Find someone else.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_guard_attitude: I won't stand guard for this.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_expedition_wound: In my state? I'm staying here.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_expedition_morale: Go out there again? Not me. I'm staying.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_expedition_attitude: I'm not going out for this.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_expedition_role: Scavenging isn't my job. I'm staying.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_defend_wound: I'm hurt, I can't hold a post.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_defend_morale: Fight for what? I'm not taking a post.
IGUI_LK_Refuse_defend_role: I'm no fighter. Count me out.
IGUI_LK_Surrender_2: Okay, okay! I'm done, I'm done!
IGUI_LK_Surrender_4: Hands up, see? I'm not fighting you!
IGUI_LK_Surrender_Betrayed_1: I gave up! What are you doing?!
